usedFor: FreJun holds the calls, and Linear receives the follow-up as “Create Customer Need” or “Create Issue”.

bestTemplate.name: “Call Outcome Change” in FreJun, then “Create Customer Need” in Linear
bestTemplate.why: An outcome change says what the call decided, so the need recorded in Linear reflects it.

watchOut: “Call Status” fires as a call moves through its lifecycle, so “Update Issue Status” can run several times per call.
